verdict: Ad efficiency surged this week; local search activity needs close attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $8,977.80 in revenue on $1,474.47 in spend — a 6.09x return — and efficiency improved sharply this past week, with your return on ad spend up nearly 56% versus the prior week. Purchase volume held steady week-over-week, so the efficiency gain reflects higher average order value rather than more transactions. On the local side, Google Business Profile actions dropped 81% this week, including three consecutive days of zero activity, which is an unusual signal we're monitoring closely. Site sessions also trended down roughly 23% over the last few days despite consistent ad spend, so we're watching whether that resolves on its own or requires a direct response next week.
